head_coach.name: Thomas Christiansen
head_coach.play_style_summary: Pragmatic and highly structured style built on defensive discipline, tactical compactness, and rapid transitions. Utilizes a double midfield pivot to control possession and overlapping full-backs to exploit wide areas, capable of shifting to a solid low block against elite opposition.

key_players.name: Amir Murillo
key_players.performance_stats: Recorded 42 tackles and 118 ball recoveries with 6 big chances created in 36 club matches, maintaining an average FotMob rating of 6.92 in the Turkish Süper Lig [3.4.4].

key_players.name: José Córdoba
key_players.performance_stats: Achieved a 7.19 average rating in the EFL Championship with 146 clearances, 28 interceptions, and 24 tackles won across 28 matches.

key_players.name: Adalberto Carrasquilla
key_players.performance_stats: Midfield engine with an average rating of 6.99, completing 1,601 minutes of play in Liga MX Clausura.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Groin injury / adductor tear suffered during the Liga MX final with Pumas UNAM; currently highly doubtful for the initial group stage games but returning to individual training [3.1.9].
